mentions.name: Moony Finance
mentions.description: Open source, local-first app for tracking personal wealth. Users can consolidate accounts, stock and crypto positions, loans, funds, and estates in one place, with data stored locally (no ads, subscriptions, or cloud) and exposed via MCP to a Claude financial advisor.
mentions.problem: Existing wealth tracking options come with ads, subscriptions, and cloud storage; the author wanted a private, local way to store and track all accounts and positions in one place.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on an open source and local app for tracking one’s wealth.

I wanted something without ads, subscriptions and cloud, where I could throw in all my accounts, stock and crypto positions, loans, funds, estates etc to have it stored and tracked on one place and via MCP exposed to my Claude financial advisor.
mentions.author: Fiiles
